question: 客户表共有多少位客户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer;

question: 来自巴西的客户有多少位？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil';

question: 曲目表中时长超过 5 分钟的曲目有多少首？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track WHERE milliseconds > 300000;

question: 列出来自巴西的客户编号、名字、姓氏和城市，按客户编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, city FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY customer_id;

question: 列出来自美国的客户编号、城市和州，按客户编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, city, state FROM customer WHERE country = 'USA' ORDER BY customer_id;

question: 列出单价高于 0.99 的前 10 首曲目的编号、名称和单价，按曲目编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, unit_price FROM track WHERE unit_price > 0.99 ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10;

gold_result.name: Battlestar Galactica: The Story So Far

question: 列出职位为 Sales Support Agent 的员工编号、名字和姓氏，按员工编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY employee_id;

question: 列出总额不少于 10 的前 10 张发票的编号、日期和总额，按发票编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE total >= 10 ORDER BY invoice_id LIMIT 10;

question: 全部发票的总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_amount FROM invoice;

question: 全部曲目的平均时长是多少毫秒？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) AS average_milliseconds FROM track;

question: 全部发票的平均总额是多少？请保留两位小数。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_total FROM invoice;

gold_revision.reason: 原题要求保留两位小数；原 AVG(total) 返回多位小数。修正版在 SQL 层执行 ROUND 并保存真实结果，不依靠评测器金额量化掩盖显示差异。

question: 客户所在国家共有多少种？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS country_count FROM customer;

question: 按客户所在国家统计客户数，先按客户数降序，并列时按国家名称升序。
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country ASC;

question: 按流派编号统计曲目数，先按曲目数降序，并列时按流派编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT genre_id, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track GROUP BY genre_id ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre_id ASC;

question: 按发票的账单国家统计销售总额，先按销售总额降序，并列时按国家名称升序。
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS sales_total FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY sales_total DESC, billing_country ASC;

question: 按员工职位统计人数，按职位名称升序。
gold_sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employee GROUP BY title ORDER BY title ASC;

question: 找出时长最长的 5 首曲目，返回编号、名称和毫秒时长；按时长降序，并列按编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, milliseconds FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 找出总额最高的 5 张发票，返回编号和总额；按总额降序，并列按编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, total FROM invoice ORDER BY total DESC, invoice_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 按姓氏降序取前 5 位客户，返回编号、名字和姓氏；姓氏相同时按客户编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer ORDER BY last_name DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 按名称升序取前 5 位艺术家，返回编号和名称；名称相同按艺术家编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT artist_id, name FROM artist ORDER BY name ASC, artist_id ASC LIMIT 5;

gold_result.name: Academy of St. Martin in the Fields & Sir Neville Marriner

question: 列出 2021 年的前 10 张发票，返回编号、日期和总额，按发票编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2021-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2022-01-01' ORDER BY invoice_id LIMIT 10;

question: 列出 2004 年 1 月 1 日之前入职的员工编号、名字（仅 first_name，不包含姓氏 last_name）和入职日期，按员工编号升序。
gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, hire_date FROM employee WHERE hire_date < '2004-01-01' ORDER BY employee_id;

gold_revision.reason: 保留原 gold 的 first_name 投影意图，明确名字的字段含义；不因旧模型额外返回 last_name 而放宽列数比较。

question: 2025 年一共开了多少张发票？

question: 列出邮箱以 @gmail.com 结尾的客户编号、名字（仅 first_name，不包含姓氏 last_name）和邮箱，按客户编号升序。

question: 查找名称含 love 的前 10 首曲目，不区分英文大小写，返回编号和名称，按曲目编号升序。
